title: Classicality of bounded-below pro-etale direct images
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a discrete commutative ring, $X,Y$ schemes, and $g:X\to Y$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism. Let $M$ be an object of the ordinary uncompleted derived category of modules over the constant pro-etale ring sheaf $\Lambda_X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with $H^q(M)=0$ for all $q<n$ for some integer $n$. Suppose every $H^q(M)$ satisfies the canonical affine-presentation continuity condition defining classicality [sk-def-pe-classical-definition]. Then every $H^q(Rg_*M)$ satisfies the same continuity condition on $Y$, where $Rg_*$ is the recorded ordinary uncompleted intrinsic module-sheaf derived direct image. No finiteness of $\Lambda$ or nonempty-scheme hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Construct intrinsicRestriction by restricting every section module along the constant-section sheafification unit. Local bijectivity of that unit makes restriction fully faithful, using restrictHomEquivOfIsLocallySurjective. For essential surjectivity sheafify the fixed-scalar module presheaf; its unit is an isomorphism because the underlying additive presheaf is already a sheaf. Thus restriction is an additive exact equivalence. No finiteness assumption is used.

Construct restrictionDirectImageIso with identity section functions. Their scalar linearity follows from the sheafification adjunction equation: the coefficient direct-image map composed with the target constant-section unit equals the source constant-section unit after base change. Restriction maps and naturality are literal sectionwise equalities.

Derive that isomorphism by rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso, rightDerivedFunctorNatIso and rightDerivedFunctorCompIso. The source equivalence preserves K-injectives; replace its right derived functor by its exact mapDerivedCategory. This identifies the recorded uncompleted intrinsic direct image with the ordinary fixed-scalar derived direct image.

Use exact-functor homology compatibility to identify classicality before and after restriction. The fixed-scalar classicality predicate uses the standard localization, so construct fixedHomologyStandardIso by fully faithful precomposition with the localization and the two homology factorization isomorphisms. Continuity-map naturality proves invariance under the resulting cohomology isomorphisms; the sectionwise restriction identifies the intrinsic and fixed-scalar continuity diagrams definitionally.

For a fixed-scalar bounded-below classical complex, the invertible bounded-below comparison unit and classicalDerivedEquivalence give an invertible counit from nu_X^* K. The existing acyclic comparison theorem gives nu_Y^* Rg_et,* K isomorphic to Rg_proet,* nu_X^* K for qcqs g. Apply the classical-essential-image clause of classicalDerivedEquivalence and invariance under isomorphism.

The exact restriction functor preserves the supplied lower bound. Regard its image as an object of D+, apply the preceding fixed-scalar result, then rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility and restrictionDerivedDirectImageIso. The cohomology/classicality identification of step 4 transports the conclusion back to the given intrinsic direct image.
